The Derivative Rows of Every Equation Under a Joint Filter

Source: R/joint_predict.R
joint_filter_jacobian.Rd

Returns the derivative of each equation's predictor in the coefficients of every equation and the joint filter's free parameters, at the fitted point, together with the first derivative of the driving vector in every predictor.

Usage

joint_filter_jacobian(spec, design, coef)

Arguments

spec

A StatmodSpec().

design

The design.

coef

The coefficients.

Value

NULL where the model carries no joint filter, otherwise a list with V (one matrix per distribution parameter), U1 (the derivative of each driving score in every predictor), G (the positions of the filtered parameters), nb, key (the names of the columns in the variance matrix), free (the filter's free parameters), f and ev.

Details

The rows of a filtered equation are the forward Jacobian of the joint recursion from joint_filter_curvature(); those of the other equations are their static designs. The columns of a held level are left out, as the variance matrix leaves them out.

See also

structural_se_columns(), joint_continued_deriv_inputs()
